sql: SELECT regexp_extract(r.abstractText, '([^.]*61[^.]*)', 1) AS sentence FROM papers LATERAL VIEW explode(resultList.result) AS r WHERE r.pmcid = 'PMC5419667' AND r.abstractText LIKE '%61%' LIMIT 5
rows: At the randomization visit (after at least 8weeks on a protocol-defined atorvastatin regimen), mean plasma LDL cholesterol was 61 (15) mg/dL and HDL cholesterol was 40 (10) mg/dL
